value.reply: The ticket title indicates an incident but the content suggests a service request. This mismatch requires clarification before routing. [JIRA-19816], [JIRA-03877], [JIRA-18213] confirm this pattern.
next_steps: Escalate to Order Management team for validation of request type
Request additional details from the submitter to clarify the issue
Reassign ticket to appropriate queue based on validated request type
